name: skillosophy
description: Discover relevant skills from a searchable library and live community sources, inspect and install a purposeful project skill set, and define specialist roles.

interface.longDescription: Start Codex projects with a clear working philosophy and useful skills. Search a source-pinned metadata library across seven upstream repositories, query the live community directory, and inspect public GitHub skill packages. Compare task fit, provenance, prerequisites, license and evidence before selecting skills. Install reviewed packages into the project with file-hash receipts and specialist role instructions. Includes philosopher lenses and practical project workflows. Popularity is not proof of improved AI performance. Runtime setup and service connections remain separate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find useful skills for this project, review the best matches, and install them with specialist role instructions.

publication.release_notes: Add a 180-entry source-pinned discovery library, live skills.sh search, public GitHub indexing, immutable source inspection, reviewed catalog extensions, and hash-verified project installation. Preserve upstream licenses and notices. Source review and popularity are distinguished from measured effectiveness.

review.commerce_description: Skillosophy is free and does not sell products or process payments. Third-party services may have their own fees.
